occurrenceChecks.sourceText: Now the name of Hebron before was Kiriath Arba, after the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land had rest from war.

previous.text: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed the LORD, the God of Israel wholeheartedly.

occurrenceChecks.sourceText: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).

previous.text: The west border was to the shore of the great sea. This is the border of the children of Judah according to their families.

next.text: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

occurrenceChecks.sourceText: They gave them Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, with its pasture lands around it.

previous.text: and they were for the children of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi; for theirs was the first lot.

next.text: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

occurrenceChecks.sourceText: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), and Zior; nine cities with their villages.
